content.short: Nightfall 3 can encrypt or hide details of token transfer transactions on EVM networks.
content.description: Nightfall 3 reduces on-chain visibility by removing recipient and token information from transfer data, thereby lowering traceability of transfers on EVM networks. Developers can run test transactions within a Docker container to examine how this approach handles different scenarios and use cases on private blockchains. This project is part of the EY Blockchain initiative. By focusing on data minimization within transfer records, Nightfall 3 provides a framework for evaluating privacy-oriented use cases in a controlled environment.
